## Promises and payoffs
- "the specific hairstyles that you should absolutely avoid": paid as three styles and four features.
- The title's "DO THIS INSTEAD": paid for each of the three styles; the four features get a fix for the parting, layers and the neck.
- "teach you how to fish": the rule of moving the eye up the shape, restated at 13:06 ("in that process of teaching you how to fish instead of giving you a fish").
- The model's look: a commenter's wish for "the ideal haristyle for this model" was not shown as a single final look.
